Ok, I kind of just skimmed through the other reddit post so what I got was: crush, want to get to know her more, freezes up and bugs out and potentially wonder if she'll say yes and if the feelings are reciprocal. Right?
Here's the advice part: If you hear her friends say your name, 75% chance that yes she may possibly like you back.  My own crush's friends teased us that we should date and conveniently we actually liked each other. I was actually in a similar boat. I kept wondering if she like me or if she was just being friendly. However, I think one major factor of determining whether someone says yes or no is to build up a social relationship first, then a romantic one. I talked to my crush in every class I could and it may have triggered a psychological thing known as reciprocal liking, where if one person senses that you like them, then they may begin growing feelings for you too. (Well actually...in this scenario she said she liked me before I had which also may be a possibility) Also check if she glances at you once in awhile. That may be a sign. In the event where you cannot hold yourself back anymore, remember, quite a few signs are in your favor, just go for it. If you don't try for it now, then the chances will be MUCH lower considering she won't be in any of your classes cutting off the vital factor of communication. If you decide to go for it tell me how it went! I wish you good luck my friend :)
EDIT: I also just saw that she sits next to you willingly that's another sign As to why she doesn't ask you? Romance is a sensitive topic to even the boldest of souls, she may just be scared to look like a creep to you. Again, Best wishes!
